notes.title: Updates and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Changes included in this version:


 fixed typo: safe crach -> safe crack
 fixed term: fencer -> fence
 fixed typo: NPCs can bust you while in their house
 add: text options for maze guy on first dialogue
 fix: lengthened backpack close from movement delay
 fix: right bumper does not buy all items
 fix: update formulas for vendor markup while buying items
 fix: update formulas for applying bargaining skill
 fix: negative weight/volume exploit
 add: message when trying to take decoy coin

Please enjoy the game :)
